title: NKX2-1 transcription factor binding site variants: trained models and code
description:
Trained VCNNBPNet models and inference code accompanying Quantification of the effects of single nucleotide variants in NKX2.1 transcription factor binding sites.

Three convolutional models, one per EMSA-seq mutant library (CORE, FLANK, ALL), predict the log2 fold change in NKX2-1 binding from DNA sequence. The weights are packaged for inference: optimizer state is stripped and the label-scaling parameters travel with the model, so predictions are returned in log2 fold change and the weights load without any dependency on the training code.

Underlying data are deposited separately: EMSA-seq reads, counts and DESeq2 results at GEO accession GSE319141; crystal structures at PDB accessions 9U18 (wildtype) and 9U19 (CACG variant). ChIP-seq peaks are from ChIP-Atlas and the position weight matrix is JASPAR MA1994.1.

Code and trained model weights are released under the MIT license. The one redistributed third-party file, the JASPAR matrix MA1994.1, remains under its own CC BY 4.0 terms.
